//: Declaration-only build for the published package.
`rootDir: "."` with `include: ["index.ts"]` makes tsc follow the entry
point's imports and emit a .d.ts for each file it reaches, laid out under
dist/types/ exactly as the sources are laid out here — so the relative
re-exports inside index.d.ts still resolve once published. Emitting only
index.d.ts produced a file pointing at ./runtime/v1/session, which does
not exist inside dist/, and the package shipped effectively untyped.
Loose settings on purpose: this emits types, it does not gate on them.
`npm test` is the gate. See scripts/common/build-dist.mjs.
